paragraphs.source_en: “Our families have stood by yours for generations, ever since Okazaki. Who among us could fail to understand our lord’s true intentions!” Tadatsugu and Tadakatsu declared loudly, thumping their chests.

units.source_en: “Our families have stood by yours for generations, ever since Okazaki. Who among us could fail to understand our lord’s true intentions!”
units.source_zh: “自冈崎以来，我们代代相守，有谁不解主公的本心！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Were Tokugawa Ieyasu twenty years younger, he would surely summon the same spirit with which he once rode across Mikatagahara, set his sights on taking the realm, and break through the Kanpaku’s encirclement!”

units.source_en: “Were Tokugawa Ieyasu twenty years younger, he would surely summon the same spirit with which he once rode across Mikatagahara, set his sights on taking the realm, and break through the Kanpaku’s encirclement!”
units.source_zh: “德川家康若能再年轻二十岁，势必会以当年驰骋三方原的气魄，以取天下为目标，突破关白的封锁！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “德川家康若能再年轻二十岁，势必会以当年驰骋三方原的气魄，以取天下为目标，突破关白的封锁！”

paragraphs.source_en: “We are ready to follow you, my lord.”

units.source_en: “We are ready to follow you, my lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: “You may say so now, but the hardships ahead may be a thousand times greater than those we face today.”

units.source_en: “You may say so now, but the hardships ahead may be a thousand times greater than those we face today.”

units.source_zh: “嘴上虽这么说，但将来的艰辛恐会千百倍于今日。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “嘴上虽这么说，但将来的艰辛恐会千百倍于今日。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes—for the sake of the realm, we must go east!”

units.source_en: “Yes—for the sake of the realm, we must go east!”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hearing you say that sets my mind at ease. From now on, you are not to complain about any arrangements I make for you!”

paragraphs.source_zh: “听你们这么说，我便放心了。以后对我的安排，不得抱怨！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, my lord!” They answered with one voice.
“I have already made preparations to keep Satomi, Satake, Hakone, Kai, and Shinano to the north under control. When the time comes, I will tolerate no discontent!”

units.source_en: “I have already made preparations to keep Satomi, Satake, Hakone, Kai, and Shinano to the north under control. When the time comes, I will tolerate no discontent!”
units.source_zh: “对于控制里见、佐竹、箱根、甲斐、北方的信浓等地，我已有准备，届时不许表示不平！”

paragraphs.source_en: “For the sake of the realm, we must always remember those bitter years when our lord was held hostage in Sunpu.” At Torii Mototada’s proposal, voices of agreement filled the room.

units.source_en: “For the sake of the realm, we must always remember those bitter years when our lord was held hostage in Sunpu.”
units.source_zh: “为了天下，我们须常回想主公当年在骏府为质的那段苦难岁月。”

units.source_zh: 在鸟居元忠的提议之下，座中一片附和之声。

paragraphs.source_zh: “为了天下，我们须常回想主公当年在骏府为质的那段苦难岁月。”在鸟居元忠的提议之下，座中一片附和之声。

paragraphs.source_en: Watching his retainers leap for joy, their minds now at ease, Ieyasu could not help wondering: How many retainers like these did Hideyoshi have?

paragraphs.source_en: Confronted with a loyalty no reward could ever purchase, Ieyasu was no less overcome than any of them. He hurriedly turned his face away and masked his sobs with laughter.
